sentences.zh: 祭太社太稷祭風雨雷師祭先農先蠶親耕藉田蠟祭釋奠文宣王武成王祭祚德廟祭司中司命景德祭社稷三首

translations.literal: Sacrifices to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain; sacrifices to the Lords of Wind, Rain, and Thunder; sacrifices to the First Farmer and First Silkworm; the Emperor's personal plowing of the sacred field; the wax sacrifice; libation offerings to King Wen the Cultured and King Wu the Martial; sacrifices at the Temple of Blessing and Virtue; sacrifices to the Director-in-the-Middle and Director of Fate; Jingde-era sacrifices to the Altars of Soil and Grain — three hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain; to the Lords of Wind, Rain, and Thunder; to the First Farmer and First Silkworm; the Emperor's plowing of the sacred field; the wax sacrifice; libation offerings to King Wen the Cultured and King Wu the Martial; sacrifices at the Temple of Blessing and Virtue; to the Director-in-the-Middle and Director of Fate; and three Jingde-era hymns for the Altars of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 降神，《靜安》百穀蕃滋，麗乎下土。

translations.literal: Descent of the Spirit, "Tranquil Peace": the hundred grains flourish and multiply, resplendent upon the lower earth.
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit — 《Tranquil Peace》: the hundred grains flourish and teem, radiant upon the earth below.

translations.literal: Reverently we exalt the bright sacrifice, handing it down through a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently exalt this bright sacrifice, to be handed down through the ages.

translations.literal: In nurturing things, only abundance; grain for the people, thus universal.
translations.idiomatic: All things are nurtured to fullness; grain reaches every people.

translations.literal: Returning to the root is altogether fitting; the state's rites are all beheld.
translations.idiomatic: It is right to repay the root; the nation's rites are manifest for all to see.

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks and pouring the libation offering, "Excellent Peace."
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks and pouring the libation — 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: Solemn is the great sacrifice; merit and benefit mutually proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the great sacrifice; merit and benefit are proclaimed together.

translations.literal: At the numinous altar, a fine recompense; through successive dynasties, clearly manifest.
translations.idiomatic: At the numinous altar we offer fine recompense, clear through every age.

translations.literal: May there be granted abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Grant abundant blessing.

translations.literal: Bestow years of abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow years of plenty.

translations.literal: The soil is fit for sowing and reaping; truly in accord with the people and Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The soil yields sowing and harvest, in true accord with the people and Heaven.

sentences.zh: 送神，《靜安》製幣犧齊，正辭無愧。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Tranquil Peace": preparing silks and sacrificial vessels, upright words without shame.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — 《Tranquil Peace》: silks and sacrificial vessels are prepared; our words are upright and without reproach.

translations.literal: With music we send it off, completing our refined intent.
translations.idiomatic: With music we send the Spirit forth, completing our refined intent.

sentences.zh: 景祐祀社稷三首迎神，《寧安》五祀之本，百貨何極？

translations.literal: Three hymns for the Jingyou sacrifice to the Altars of Soil and Grain — Welcoming the Spirit, "Serene Peace": the root of the five sacrifices — what limit to the hundred goods?
translations.idiomatic: Three Jingyou hymns for the Altars of Soil and Grain — Welcoming the Spirit, 《Serene Peace》: the root of the five sacrifices — what limit to the hundred goods?

translations.literal: The Way is manifest from the opening of creation; grace extends to all that moves and all that grows.
translations.idiomatic: The Way was manifest from the opening of creation; its grace reaches all that moves and grows.

translations.literal: The state honors fine grain; the people rely on the strength of tillage.
translations.idiomatic: The state honors fine grain; the people live by the labor of the fields.

translations.literal: In presenting offerings, only reverence; the numinous spirits come to approach.
translations.idiomatic: We present offerings in reverence; the numinous spirits draw near.

translations.literal: First offering — ascending and descending, "Upright Peace";
translations.idiomatic: First offering — ascending and descending, 《Upright Peace》;

sentences.zh: 太社、後土、太稷、後稷奠玉幣，並《嘉安》；

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks to the Great Altar of Soil, Queen Earth, Great Altar of Grain, and Lord Millet — all to "Excellent Peace";
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks to the Great Altar of Soil, Queen Earth, Great Altar of Grain, and Lord Millet — all to 《Excellent Peace》;

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, "Abundant Peace."
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray — 《Abundant Peace》.

translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Same as before) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Same as before.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: Period.
Second and final offerings, "Cultured Peace";
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings — 《Cultured Peace》;

sentences.zh: 送神，《寧安》神之來兮，降茲下土。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Serene Peace": the spirit comes — descending to this lower earth.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — 《Serene Peace》: the spirit comes, descending to this lower earth.

translations.literal: The spirit departs — far off, without place.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit departs — vanished, without trace of place.

translations.literal: The altar mound is solemn; silks are buried and the tray withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The altar stands solemn; silks are buried and the sacrificial tray is cleared away.

translations.literal: The achievement of grain — foremost through ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: The achievement of grain surpasses all through the ages.

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, "Abundant Peace."
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray — 《Abundant Peace》.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

sentences.zh: （神州地祇、皇地祇與社稷通用。）〉

translations.literal: (Used in common for the Spirit of the Central Land, the Imperial Earth Spirit, and the Altars of Soil and Grain.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used in common for the Spirit of the Central Land, the Imperial Earth Spirit, and the Altars of Soil and Grain.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

sentences.zh: 禮崇明禋，維馨斯酒，潔粢豐盛，殺時享牡。

translations.literal: The rite reverently exalts the bright sacrifice; only fragrant is this wine; pure grain offerings, abundant and full; at the season, a bull is slain for offering.
translations.idiomatic: The rite reverently exalts the bright sacrifice; fragrant is this wine; pure grain offerings abound; at the proper season a bull is offered.

translations.literal: Solemn, reverent, and respectful; ascending to burn upon the kindling pile.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and reverent, we ascend to burn upon the kindling pile.

translations.literal: What is the recompense for this?
translations.idiomatic: What recompense shall we receive?

translations.literal: Like mountains, like mounds.
translations.idiomatic: Like mountains, like great mounds.

sentences.zh: 大觀祀社稷九首迎神，《寧安》

translations.literal: Nine hymns for the Daguan sacrifice to the Altars of Soil and Grain — Welcoming the Spirit, "Serene Peace."
translations.idiomatic: Nine Daguan hymns for the Altars of Soil and Grain — Welcoming the Spirit, 《Serene Peace》.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾二奏惟土之尊，民食資焉。

translations.literal: Two performances in Yellow Bell mode: only the soil is honored; the people's food relies upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Two performances in Yellow Bell mode: the soil alone is honored; the people's food depends upon it.

translations.literal: The yin sacrifice is clearly approached; oxen and pens, raw and savory.
translations.idiomatic: The yin sacrifice draws near; oxen and pens, raw and savory, are offered.

translations.literal: Meritorious toward the people — announcing its auspicious purity.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious toward the people — we announce its auspicious purity.

translations.literal: The spirit comes to enjoy the offering; cloud chariots flutter lightly.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit comes to receive the offering; cloud chariots drift lightly.

translations.literal: Two performances in Great Cluster mode, horn.
translations.idiomatic: Two performances in Great Cluster mode, horn.

translations.literal: Spirit of grain alone — nurturing within, without end.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit of grain — nurturing within without end.

translations.literal: The hundred excellences flourish and multiply; the people rely upon its merit.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred good things flourish; the people rely upon its merit.

translations.literal: Strictly arrayed are the altar mounds; august bearing, solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: The altar mounds are strictly arrayed; august bearing, solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: The spirit comes to enjoy the offering; we pray for abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit comes to receive the offering; we pray for abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 姑洗徵二奏猗歟那歟，生養斯民！

translations.literal: Two performances in Maiden Wash mode, zhi: how fine, how glorious — nurturing and sustaining these people!
translations.idiomatic: Two performances in Maiden Wash mode, zhi: how fine, how glorious — nurturing and sustaining the people!

translations.literal: Households supplied, people content; the age reaches serene purity.
translations.idiomatic: Households are supplied and the people content; the age reaches serene purity.

translations.literal: Reverently solemn is the bright sacrifice; in offering, fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently solemn is the bright sacrifice; we offer fragrant gifts.

translations.literal: Grain offerings abundant and pure; the spirit then has heard.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings are abundant and pure; the spirit hears.

sentences.zh: 南呂羽二奏籩豆斯陳，三牲告幽。

translations.literal: Two performances in Southern Pitch mode, yu: baskets and stands are thus displayed; the three sacrificial animals announce to the hidden realm.
translations.idiomatic: Two performances in Southern Pitch mode, yu: baskets and stands are set forth; the three sacrificial animals announce to the hidden realm.

translations.literal: The rite of returning to the root — answering the spirit's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The rite of returning to the root answers the spirit's blessing.

translations.literal: Come to savor fragrant aroma; abundant harvest in autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Come to savor fragrant offerings; abundant harvest in autumn.

translations.literal: Granaries and bins by the tens of thousands; governance matches the Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries and bins number in the tens of thousands; governance matches the Zhou.

sentences.zh: 初獻升降，《正安》崇崇廣壇，嚴恭祀事。

translations.literal: First offering — ascending and descending, "Upright Peace": lofty, lofty is the broad altar; solemn and reverent the sacrificial affair.
translations.idiomatic: First offering — ascending and descending, 《Upright Peace》: lofty is the broad altar; solemn and reverent is the sacrifice.

translations.literal: August bearing most timely; turning and advancing, halting and withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: August bearing perfectly timed; we turn, advance, and withdraw in due order.

translations.literal: Ringing like jade pendants on a girdle; sincerity reaches the hidden realm.
translations.idiomatic: Ringing like jade pendants; sincerity reaches the hidden realm.

translations.literal: Mutually assisting in agricultural planting; the state, all of it, is blessed.
translations.idiomatic: Together we assist in planting; the state is wholly blessed.

translations.literal: Presenting silks, "Excellent Peace."
translations.idiomatic: Presenting silks — 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: Ah, the yin sacrifice — enfeoffing the soil, only exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, the yin sacrifice — enfeoffing the soil, supremely exalted.

translations.literal: At this auspicious hour — savor us, drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: At this auspicious hour — accept our drums and bells.

translations.literal: Gentle and still, transforming radiance; people rely upon its merit.
translations.idiomatic: Gentle and still, transforming radiance; the people rely upon its merit.

translations.literal: Displaying these measured silks; the hundred goods are thus honored.
translations.idiomatic: We display these measured silks; the hundred goods are thus honored.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《嘉安》坤元生物，功利相宣。

translations.literal: Pouring the libation offering, "Excellent Peace": the Kun origin generates things; merit and benefit mutually proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the libation — 《Excellent Peace》: the Kun origin generates all things; merit and benefit are proclaimed together.

translations.literal: Purifying this sacrificial affair; fine recompense, reaching utmost reverence.
translations.idiomatic: We purify this sacrifice; fine recompense reaches utmost reverence.

translations.literal: Clear libation, fragrant as orchids; the numinous altar stands towering.
translations.idiomatic: Clear libation, fragrant as orchids; the numinous altar stands towering.

translations.literal: Pouring from the goblet, presenting the cup — may the spirit approach!
translations.idiomatic: We pour from the goblet and present the cup — may the spirit draw near!

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》薦嘉亶時，洋洋來格。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, "Cultured Peace": presenting excellence at the proper season; vast and full, they come to approach.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings — 《Cultured Peace》: we present excellence at the proper season; vast and full, the spirits draw near.

translations.literal: Ascending this altar; pure and bright, only reverent.
translations.idiomatic: We ascend this altar, pure and bright in reverence.

translations.literal: The spirit thereby dwells and savors; smoothly completing agricultural harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit dwells and savors; the harvest is smoothly completed.

translations.literal: Its height like a wall; its density like a comb's teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Its height like a wall; its density like comb teeth.

sentences.zh: 送神，《寧安》尊罍芬香，威儀肅雍。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, "Serene Peace": goblets and jars, fragrant aroma; august bearing, solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit — 《Serene Peace》: goblets and jars are fragrant; august bearing, solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: The numinous heart approves and halts; vast and full, mutual communion.
translations.idiomatic: The numinous heart approves; vast communion is achieved.

translations.literal: The spirit returns, bestowing blessing; years repeatedly abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit returns, bestowing blessing; year after year is abundant.

translations.literal: Granaries and bins by the tens of thousands; comforting our three classes of farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries and bins number in the tens of thousands; comfort for our farmers.

sentences.zh: 紹興祀太社太稷十七首

translations.literal: Seventeen hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the Great Altars of Soil and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Shaoxing hymns for the Great Altars of Soil and Grain.

translations.literal: Welcoming the Spirit uses "Serene Peace"; Bell Casket as tonic.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the Spirit uses 《Serene Peace》; Bell Casket as tonic.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Used for the Spring Community sacrifice.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used for the Spring Community sacrifice.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: The root of the five sacrifices — the Altars of Soil and Grain have solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: The root of the five sacrifices — the Altars of Soil and Grain are solemn.

translations.literal: Clearing brush and oak trees has just begun — who would dare not be reverent?
translations.idiomatic: Clearing brush and oak has just begun — who would dare be less than reverent?

translations.literal: The auspicious day is only wu; thus we present baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: On the auspicious wu day we present baskets and stands.

translations.literal: May the spirit come to approach — granting years of abundance!
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit draw near and grant years of abundance!

translations.literal: Bell Casket as tonic.
translations.idiomatic: Bell Casket as tonic.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Used for the Autumn Community and wax sacrifices.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used for the Autumn Community and wax sacrifices.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: Meritorious achievement rests with the people; greatly receiving dew and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious achievement rests with the people; greatly receiving dew and rain.

translations.literal: "Good Plough" having been sung, then raising the shield-dance.
translations.idiomatic: After 《Good Plough》 is sung, the shield-dance is performed.

translations.literal: Thus presenting, thus honoring; thick rites are thus performed.
translations.idiomatic: We present and honor; rich rites are thus performed.

translations.literal: Look to its abundant year — much early rice, much millet.
translations.idiomatic: Look to its abundant year — early rice and millet in plenty.

translations.literal: Great Cluster as horn.
translations.idiomatic: Great Cluster as horn.

translations.literal: Thus honoring, thus presenting; here following the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: We honor and present; here we follow the old regulations.

translations.literal: Music's tones pure and continuous; offerings overflow, round and square.
translations.idiomatic: Music's tones are pure and continuous; offerings overflow, round and square.

translations.literal: Sentiment and pattern are complete; may the spirit come to taste!
translations.idiomatic: Sentiment and pattern are complete; may the spirit come to taste!

translations.literal: Forever behold the granted bounty — abundant harvest, teeming.
translations.idiomatic: Forever behold the granted bounty — harvest abundant and teeming.

sentences.zh: 姑洗為徵穀資土養，民賴穀生。

translations.literal: Maiden Wash as zhi: grain relies on soil's nurture; people rely on grain for life.
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash as zhi: grain relies on the soil's nurture; the people live by grain.

translations.literal: Merit and benefit so vast — none compare with it.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and benefit so vast — none can compare.

translations.literal: Thus solemn is the sacrificial altar; through things, presenting sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the sacrificial altar; through offerings we present sincerity.

translations.literal: Rites complete, music performed — only the spirit looks down and savors.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are complete and music performed; may the spirit look down and savor.

sentences.zh: 南呂為羽國主社稷，時祀有常。

translations.literal: Southern Pitch as yu: the state honors the Altars of Soil and Grain; seasonal sacrifices have fixed times.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Pitch as yu: the state honors the Altars of Soil and Grain; seasonal sacrifices follow fixed times.

translations.literal: Solemn as the old regulations; returning to the root, never forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn as the old regulations; we never forget to return to the root.

translations.literal: Grain offerings abundant and pure; singing and chanting of green and yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings are abundant and pure; we sing of green and yellow harvest.

translations.literal: The honored spirit suddenly comes; the hundred things attend as guests.
translations.idiomatic: The honored spirit suddenly arrives; the hundred things attend as guests.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《正安》祭重齊肅，神格專精。

translations.literal: Hand-washing, 《Upright Peace》: the sacrifice is weighty, solemn and reverent; the spirit approaches with focused purity.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing, 《Upright Peace》: the sacrifice is weighty and solemn; the spirit approaches in focused purity.

translations.literal: Pouring water for washing at the eastern steps; pure cleanliness showing sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Water is poured for washing at the eastern steps; pure cleanliness shows our sincerity.

translations.literal: Clear and bright is the aromatic wine; the glorious affair is fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and bright is the aromatic wine; the glorious rite is fully complete.

translations.literal: Continuing as before, extending onward — like an islet, like a mound.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing as before, extending onward, like islets and great mounds.

translations.literal: Ascending the altar, 《Upright Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the altar, 《Upright Peace》.

translations.literal: The Way of the numinous earth — grain food has priority.
translations.idiomatic: The Way of the numinous earth: grain food comes first.

translations.literal: Each year, reverently praying and reporting; rites strict, baskets and stands solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Each year we reverently pray and report; rites are strict, baskets and stands solemn.

translations.literal: Descending, ascending, unadorned presentation.
translations.idiomatic: We descend and ascend in unadorned presentation.

translations.literal: None who is not reverent.
translations.idiomatic: None among us fails in reverence.

translations.literal: Continuing as before, extending onward — fitting to have repeated abundant years.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing as before, extending onward, we should have year after year of abundance.

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet in spring and autumn.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet in spring and autumn.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: When the soil opens forth, then sacrifice — to the agricultural auspice we pray.
translations.idiomatic: When the soil opens forth we sacrifice and pray to the agricultural auspice.

translations.literal: Baskets and stands added to the hamper; canonical rites have their rules.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets and stands are added to the hamper; canonical rites have their rules.

translations.literal: Only these jade tablets and silks — used to announce solemn reverence.
translations.idiomatic: With these jade tablets and silks we announce solemn reverence.

translations.literal: The numinous spirits descend to observe; grant us abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May the numinous spirits descend to observe and grant us abundant blessing.

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet in autumn and wax sacrifices.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet in autumn and wax sacrifices.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: Splendid is the Ancestress Spirit; sowing and reaping she oversees.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid is the Ancestress Spirit; she oversees sowing and reaping.

translations.literal: Just now is the gathering of the harvest; returning to the root is altogether fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Now is the harvest gathered; it is right to return to the root.

translations.literal: Fine altar established for sacrifice; jade and silks displayed in ritual array.
translations.idiomatic: A fine altar is established for sacrifice; jade and silks are displayed in ritual array.

translations.literal: The bright spirit clearly approaches; granting abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The bright spirit clearly approaches, granting abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 還位，《正安》國主太祀，地道聿神。

translations.literal: Returning to position, 《Upright Peace》: the state honors the great sacrifice; the earth's Way is numinous.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to position, 《Upright Peace》: the state honors the great sacrifice; the earth's Way is numinous.

translations.literal: Millet oversees the hundred grains; benefit and nurture, only equal.
translations.idiomatic: Millet oversees the hundred grains; benefit and nurture are equally shared.

translations.literal: On the selected day, newly auspicious; grain offerings fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: On the newly auspicious selected day, grain offerings are fragrant.

translations.literal: The spirit feasts at ease; blessing these people below.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit feasts at ease, blessing the people below.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》嘉承天和，黍稷翼翼。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Peace》: finely receiving Heaven's harmony; millet and panicled millet, abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Peace》: finely receiving Heaven's harmony; millet and panicled millet abound.

translations.literal: Silently assisting agricultural labor — it is the spirit's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Silently assisting agricultural labor, it is the spirit's virtue.

translations.literal: The tray holds sacrificial victims; the old regulations are the model.
translations.idiomatic: The tray holds sacrificial victims; we follow the old regulations as our model.

translations.literal: Continuing with abundant years; our granaries number in the hundreds of millions.
translations.idiomatic: May abundant years continue; our granaries number in the hundreds of millions.

translations.literal: Pouring the libation at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the libation at the Great Altar of Soil position, 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: An opening editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet at the Spring Community sacrifice.) closing editorial bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (Used in common for the Great Altar of Grain, Lord of Soil, and Lord Millet at the Spring Community sacrifice.) Closing bracket for a rubric note.

translations.literal: Enfeoffing the soil, exalted sacrifice; meritorious achievement rests with the people.
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffing the soil in exalted sacrifice; meritorious achievement rests with the people.

translations.literal: Through a thousand ages, undimmed; blessing this multitude of people.
translations.idiomatic: Undimmed through a thousand ages, blessing this multitude of people.

translations.literal: Washing the goblet, presenting the cup; there is wine, and it is fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: We wash the goblet and present the cup; the wine is fragrant.

translations.literal: The spirit is fully intoxicated and halts; harmonious joy, delighted and pleased.

translations.idiomatic: Ascending and descending, 《Reverent Peace》: girdle pendant relaxed; girdle rings ringing clearly.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending above and below; altar fire bright.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending and descending above and below; altar fire bright.

translations.literal: Washing in the jar; towel on the towel rack.
translations.idiomatic: Washing in the jar; towel on the towel rack.

translations.literal: Not boisterous, not proud; perhaps to pacify the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Not boisterous, not proud; perhaps to pacify the spirit.

sentences.zh: 奠幣，《容安》我誠既潔，我豆既豐。

translations.literal: Presenting silks, 《Graceful Peace》: our sincerity already pure; our stands already abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting silks, 《Graceful Peace》: our sincerity already pure; our stands already abundant.

translations.literal: Spirit's coming descent timed; dignified is its bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit's coming descent timed; dignified is its bearing.

translations.literal: Presenting this fine silk; solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting this fine silk; solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: How to assist it?
translations.idiomatic: How to assist it?

translations.literal: With music, drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: With music, drums and bells.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《雍安》酌茲旨酒，既盈且芬。

translations.literal: Pouring the libation, 《Harmonious Peace》: pour this fine wine; already full and fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the libation, 《Harmonious Peace》: pour this fine wine; already full and fragrant.

translations.literal: Thereby coming to savor; joyful, joyful, fragrant and warm.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby coming to savor; joyful, fragrant and warm.

translations.literal: How to pacify the spirit?
translations.idiomatic: How to pacify the spirit?

translations.literal: Presenting fine baskets.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting fine baskets.

translations.literal: How to bestow upon the people?
translations.idiomatic: How to bestow upon the people?

translations.literal: That is abundant years.
translations.idiomatic: That is abundant years.

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, 《Joyful Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, 《Joyful Peace》.

translations.literal: Clouds, drifting, drifting; wind, sharp, sharp.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds drifting; wind sharp.

translations.literal: Whirling escort returning to empty space; bright sun coming to rise.
translations.idiomatic: Whirling escort returning to empty space; bright sun coming to rise.

translations.literal: Returning banners raised, raised; assembled music ringing clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Returning banners raised; assembled music ringing clearly.

translations.literal: Our spirit thus rejoices; favoring us with fine auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Our spirit thus rejoices; favoring us with fine auspiciousness.

translations.literal: Five Dragons — six hymns — Welcoming the Spirit, 《Auspicious Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Five Dragons, six hymns, Welcoming the Spirit, 《Auspicious Peace》.

translations.literal: Spirit's wisdom — leaping through Han, hidden and deep.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit's wisdom, leaping through Han, hidden and deep.

translations.literal: Wishing to tame and soothe — without Dong and Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing to tame and soothe, without Dong and Liu.

translations.literal: Displaying metal and stone; assisting and supporting victims and delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Displaying metal and stone; assisting and supporting victims and delicacies.

translations.literal: Perhaps feasting; grace responding to people's request.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps feasting; grace responding to people's request.

sentences.zh: 升降，《雅安》靈之至兮，逸駕騰驤。

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, 《Elegant Peace》: spirit's arrival — resting carriage galloping and prancing.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending and descending, 《Elegant Peace》: spirit's arrival, resting carriage galloping and prancing.

translations.literal: Exhaling clouds, inhaling qi; receiving sacrifice in sunlight.
translations.idiomatic: Exhaling clouds, inhaling qi; receiving sacrifice in sunlight.

translations.literal: Displaying odes, sounding pitch; solemn and splendid, clear and ringing.
translations.idiomatic: Displaying odes, sounding pitch; solemn and splendid, clear and ringing.

translations.literal: How to receive the spirit?
translations.idiomatic: How to receive the spirit?

translations.literal: Bestowed grace without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowed grace without bound.

sentences.zh: 奠幣，《文安》維靈德兮，變化不常。

translations.literal: Presenting silks, 《Cultured Peace》: only numinous virtue; transformation not constant.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting silks, 《Cultured Peace》: only numinous virtue; transformation not constant.

translations.literal: Pouring heavenly grace; flowing through eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring heavenly grace; flowing through eight directions.

translations.literal: Presenting fine silks; solemn, not forgetting.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting fine silks; solemn, not forgetting.

translations.literal: Forever protecting the people; granting abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Forever protecting the people; granting abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《愷安》練吉日兮，進神之堂。

translations.literal: Pouring the libation, 《Harmonious Peace》: selecting auspicious day; entering the spirit's hall.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the libation, 《Harmonious Peace》: selecting auspicious day; entering the spirit's hall.

translations.literal: Victims already displayed; grain offerings already fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Victims already displayed; grain offerings already fragrant.

translations.literal: Presenting cassia wine; leisurely with fine cups.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting cassia wine; leisurely with fine cups.

translations.literal: Spirit peacefully remaining; granting us blessing and auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit peacefully remaining; granting us blessing and auspiciousness.

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, 《Excellent Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, 《Excellent Peace》.

translations.literal: Bright, bright Son of Heaven; ritual pattern all in order.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Son of Heaven; ritual pattern all in order.

translations.literal: Especially the spirit's achievement; spanning the nine domains.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit's achievement extends across the nine domains.

translations.literal: Cloud bestowing called the people; things produce and multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds bestow grace upon the people; all things grow and multiply.

translations.literal: Fine receiving grace and harmony; without end or limit.
translations.idiomatic: We finely receive grace and harmony without end or limit.

sentences.zh: 送神，《登安》靈之來下，以雨先驅。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, 《Ascending Peace》: spirit's coming down; with rain going first.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, 《Ascending Peace》: as the spirit descends, rain goes before it.

translations.literal: Spirit's turning carriage; five clouds binding the chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit's turning carriage is bound by five clouds.

translations.literal: Operating ring responding to summer; opening casket, auspicious Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The operating ring responds to summer; opening the casket brings auspicious Yu.

translations.literal: True person at the imperial seat; coming to present the precious talisman.
translations.idiomatic: The true person at the imperial seat comes to present the precious talisman.
